extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The European Medicines Agency (EMA) has authorized panitumumab in combination with FOLFOX for the first-line treatment of patients with wild-type KRAS metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). Panitumumab's product information further states that evidence of wild-type KRAS status is required before initiating treatment with panitumumab and that KRAS mutational status should be determined using a validated test method by an experienced laboratory.
